acceptance.behavior: Authenticated desktop and mobile navigation signs the user out and performs a document-safe redirect from /dashboard to /login.
The shared authenticated shell exposes responsive Sign out controls with a disabled busy state and an announced recoverable error.
Logout revokes authentication sessions without deleting or mutating the durable Supabase Auth identity or profile authority record.
Supabase Auth remains the session authority and global sign-out revokes refresh sessions for the authenticated identity.
The browser journey writes the required exact-revision desktop, mobile, trace, accessibility, and result artifacts after execution.
One Playwright spec exercises real login and logout twice across desktop and mobile, validates cookie removal and durable records, and emits PBOS artifacts.
Sign out is a labeled native button, progress and failure states are conveyed programmatically, mobile overflow is rejected, and axe blocks serious or critical violations.
Logout requests provider-wide refresh-session revocation, clears Supabase browser cookies, and never exposes provider error details.
